question: Is the BULL vol gate (rv_60d<rv_252d) cross-era divergence (modern EARNS in grinds vs 1970s WHIPSAW) a data-frequency artifact or a genuine regime distinction?

refs: bull_qqq_live.py:148 monthly resample is TREND/canary panel only, NOT vol gate

1970s.windows: trailing 60 / 252 trading days, sampled at month-end
1970s.source_series: research/data_1970s/gspc_daily.csv Yahoo ^GSPC true daily close, 4770 obs 1967-1985 (NOT monthly, NOT interpolated)
refs: research/stagflation_1970s_trend_vol.py:29-40,185,195 docs daily ^GSPC for vol gate only

modern_2022.detail: rv60 crossed above rv252 at onset 2021-11 (+0.5pp) and stayed above all of 2022 (rising to +8.8pp 2022-06); de-risk 11/12 months 2022

modern_2018Q4.detail: rv60 above rv252 Feb-May then re-crossed above Oct/Nov/Dec (0.146>0.140, 0.177>0.149, 0.240>0.170) into Q4 selloff

1970s_1977_82.detail: rv60 stayed BELOW rv252 (risk-on) entire first 10 mo of 1977 bleed (1977-01..1977-10, spread -0.2 to -2.2pp); never de-risked, rode it down. Full window 72 mo: 36 risk-on / 36 de-risk (coin-flip), 15 state flips = whipsaw

mechanism: Gate de-risks on rv60>=rv252 (short-term vol expanding above trailing-year baseline). EARNS when grind arrives with vol expansion (2018-Q4, 2022); FAILS/blind when grind is low-vol-persistent (1977-82) so crossover never trips and gate rides down.
verdict_text: Genuine regime distinction (vol-expansion grind vs low-vol-persistent grind). NOT a data-frequency artifact -- both eras use real daily returns, identical windows and annualization. Vol-gate grind-protection is real but CONDITIONAL: repeatable for vol-expansion grinds, structurally blind to low-vol-persistent grinds. Do not generalize 'earns in grinds' to all grinds.
caveats: 1970s vol gate price-only ^GSPC (no dividends) -- irrelevant for realized vol
1970s equity return Shiller monthly TR; trend signal Shiller monthly-avg price -- orthogonal to vol gate
modern simple vs 1970s log daily returns -- immaterial for daily-window rv
study isolates rv state/mechanism; full P&L already in cited decomp/stagflation findings
memory_candidate: Process lesson: when a backtest verdict flips across eras, confirm the SIGNAL's input frequency in each harness before attributing to regime; here both were daily so the flip was genuine regime, not artifact.
knowledge_candidate: Vol-gate (rv60<rv252) grind-protection is conditional: de-risks only on short-term vol EXPANSION; earns in vol-expansion grinds (2018-Q4, 2022), blind to low-vol-persistent grinds (1977-82 stagflation).
